name: cinematic-app-framework

scripts.lint: oxlint src tests scripts desktop electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run check:scaffold && npm test && npm run build
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run build -- --base=./ && node scripts/stage-desktop.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --dir --publish never
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build -- --base=./ && node scripts/stage-desktop.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never

description: An AI-ready React app template with a cinematic shell, model scaffold, validated model registry, Finder, Toolbox, and live learning panels.
